owner_direction: Always show the best available registered model output before market, EV, disposition, acquisition, or technical state.
rules: Market, personnel, refresh, uncertainty, or action blockers may not erase an available forecast.
A missing price yields EV_UNAVAILABLE, never MODEL_OUTPUT_UNAVAILABLE.
A pending refresh must display the latest eligible registered output as PRELIMINARY_ASOF when one exists, with exact cutoff and an append-only supersession rule.
A replacement crossing 50 percent must update side, probability, matching price, EV, and disposition together.
NO_FORECAST is legal only when no competition-eligible model exists for that phase, target, and cohort; historical model lineage and exclusion reason remain visible.
Reader View order is active model output, strength, market comparison, action disposition, then collapsed evidence.
Totals and spreads remain distinct targets and may not be translated into EV without a registered distribution.

reader_vocabulary.PRELIMINARY_ASOF: Early model output; scheduled refresh may supersede
reader_vocabulary.NO_COMPETITION_ELIGIBLE_MODEL: No model covers this competition phase
reader_vocabulary.EV_UNAVAILABLE: Model output exists; a required market or uncertainty input does not
